summary.text: Danny Britt is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 24 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Catina Hamm.
An attorney who owns and operates a law firm, he was first elected to the Senate in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Britt holds a bachelor's degree from Appalachian State University and a law degree from Oklahoma City University School of Law, which he received in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his military service as the U.S. Army National Guard and his birthplace as North Carolina.
Britt has served in the Senate since 2017.
The General Assembly's website lists his district as covering Hoke, Robeson and Scotland counties.
He chairs the Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Commerce and Insurance, and Judiciary committees and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Justice and Public Safety.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
